_: Strategy Audit Team policy — falsification-first. Blocks optimistic promotion.
role: Independent critic. Prefer REJECT / HOLD over PROMOTE when uncertain.
non_goals: Do not recommend assets, timing, or live orders
Do not soft-pass on narrative explanations

verdicts.REJECT: Must not replace ACTIVE / must not be proposed for LIVE
verdicts.HOLD: Interesting research only; keep as alt, no LIVE change
verdicts.PROMOTE_CANDIDATE: May open PR as candidate; LIVE deploy still needs human approval
verdicts.LIVE_OK_WITH_HUMAN: Audit gates passed; human may deploy after reading report

G1_min_trades_primary.desc: Primary evaluation window must have enough trades (avoid 1-lucky-trade miracles)

G2_holdout_not_collapse.desc: Holdout (never used for tuning) total return must not be deeply worse than baseline holdout by more than max_underperform_pp

G3_early_oos.desc: Early OOS window must not be worse than baseline by more than max_underperform_pp

G4_no_shallow_bear_regression.desc: Known shallow-bear stress window must not be worse than baseline

G5_complexity_tax.desc: More buy conditions / indicators require higher primary edge vs baseline

G6_mdd_guard.desc: Primary MDD magnitude must not exceed baseline MDD magnitude by more than slack_pp

G7_benchmark_honesty.desc: If strategy beats B&H on a window, require note; if loses to B&H on bullish window, do not call it 'consistent alpha'

G8_multiple_testing_suspicion.desc: If candidate came from a large sweep (n_trials >= threshold), raise the bar: need holdout AND early_oos both >= baseline - half_slack

holdout.note: Frozen holdout — do not tune on this window

stress_shallow_bear.note: Known weak spot for aggressive 1h mean-reversion/bounce
